description: Use this when the user asks about a player's prop lines, how often he clears a line, or today's prop board. Returns, for a player_id, one compact row per stat with a line for his next game: the consensus line and book count, his last five games against it (`l5`, values newest first) and his season average, and for an NFL player `target_share` (his share of his team's targets in its games since he joined, the season and its last 3, all and in the red zone, each `[share, targets, team targets, games]`; with Pro `teammates`, each teammate's slice `[name, targets, share]`); signed in, the last ten (`l10`, newest first), his record against the closing line and `trend_lenses` (his record at the line against his next opponent this season and last, at its venue, and without each regular teammate out or doubtful tonight, each `[lens, over, under, push]`; facts, not picks) and (NBA) `minutes_trend` (his minutes a game in his last five against this season's games before, whole game and first quarter, `[minutes|first_quarter, last 5, before, games before]`, only on a gap of a minute or more); with Keel Stats Pro also L20 and season hit rates, the opening line and move, the market's vig-free chance of the over with how many books it comes from (`market_over`, `market_books`; none from a single book), the best price at the consensus line (`best_over`/`best_under` name their line; a better line at another book follows as `other_line`), the matchup and (NBA) `open_looks`, his shooting by defender distance beside what his next opponent allows at each distance, (NBA points, PRA and threes) `guarded_by`, who most often guarded him in earlier meetings among his next opponent's available players (the top name on every step; Pro his points per 100 against each, the difference to his own rate and the share-weighted difference), and (NBA points, rebounds, assists) his last games' result, closing line and tracking rates (`opportunity_games`, a few without Pro), and with `detail` the book-by-book odds (each book's price at the consensus line against the books' typical one, `vs_typical`: a price comparison, not a value estimate), closing lines, game log, history, alternate ladders and `moves_with` (partners' over rates when he goes over and when he goes under). Without a player_id, today's prop board: `recent` is the last five values newest first, `status` the injury report's (questionable, doubtful…), `minutes_l5` and `fga_l5`/`tpa_l5` the last five games' minutes and attempts; players ruled out are listed in `ruled_out`, not in the rows (Pro: the market's vig-free chance, the daily cheat sheet of the biggest line moves since the open, and the `consistent` filter). The answer's `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Not for picks: it is research only and never gives a pick.

consistent.description: Optional, the board only (Keel Stats Pro): true keeps the players whose last 5 and last 10 games both went one way against today's line (70%+ over, or 70%+ under), read over the whole board before it is cut to its rows.

date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the NBA daily prop board.

detail.description: With a player_id (Keel Stats Pro): "compact" (default), "full" (every section, the long answer), or a comma-separated list of sections: "books" (book-by-book odds and history), "ladders" (alternate lines graded), "closes" (closing lines per game), "games" (the game log with closes), "history" (record against the close by season), "moves_with" (his partners in his next game: when he goes over, how often each went over, and when he goes under).

game_id.description: Optional numeric game ID to filter the daily prop board to a single game.

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID to inspect his lines for the next game. Omit for the daily prop board.

stat.description: Optional stat code: narrows a player's rows and sections, or picks the board's stat (e.g. NBA: "pts", "reb", "ast", "tpm", "pra"; NFL: "passing_yards", "rushing_yards", "receiving_yards", "receptions").
